items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: And Cap, Kit Howard, George Gano, they'd know what time the L&N train. At that time they had the L&N, you know what I mean? At that time, well, they'd meet the train and they'd come get me from the L&N station.

ctx.x: He weren't completely left out then?

No. Cap used to send for me. And Cap, Kit Howard, George Gano, they'd know what time the L&N train. At that time they had the L&N, you know what I mean? At that time, well, they'd meet the train and they'd come get me from the L&N station. Howard was living on Begunna Street too at that time. And they'd come meet me at the L&N station. And, no, I didn't know anything about the city. Where they'd take me, I didn't know. All I would do was go. I do know one place that Cap told my mother and dad in a letter that he…
And the menches would be 12 feet long, about. About a 12 foot long men, something like that.
